question: Since when has Prof. Mama Foupouagnigni been Centre President of AIMS-Cameroon?
answer: Prof. Mama Foupouagnigni is Professor of Mathematics at the University of Yaoundé I, Cameroon, and Centre President of AIMS-Cameroon since August 2016, after having been the founding Academic Director of the same Institute.
